## T39 Stage E–H hand-back — 2026-11-02T19:21:11Z

Push completed with normal hooks; the remote-tracking ref equals this tip and `git status --short` is empty. The historical launch worktree was not edited.

Executed dispatch [6585180759](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/686#issuecomment-6585180759) and [stream brief v2 at 7f25f9f78b3da3a6b2c893397b58a3ce5a04be75](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/7f25f9f78b3da3a6b2c893397b58a3ce5a04be75/docs/reviews/briefs/t39-streams.md), with no pre-E merge. Both complete work-log append sequences were preserved and INDEX regenerated. The two required hash fields are now populated only in this issue’s header and were read back exactly.

Current observed executor: **Codex / GPT-6-Astra / xhigh**, session `01a19d12-0c07-7ba3-88b8-ab9d609f4d67`, T1 `wN:p4`. Historical A–D identities, primary.model `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`, lab `anthropic`, Local depth and reviewers `[]` remain intact. Accepted A–D tests were not replayed.

### Verification and integration provenance

Every source stream passed the whole candidate harness before its commit and the committed-artifact harness afterward, plus rules check; map changes report **0 missing**. The final published tip was then checked in both normal and withheld-findings modes: **rc=0, 13/13**. Finding exceptions are empty; 59 legitimate and five inherited entries remain.

The initial merged run was 12/13 solely because its ownership history scan counted 113 authorized coordinator changes as lane edits. The audit-local Stage-H mode accepts **only** the owner-named coordinator hash, excludes only that reachable history, and independently requires every non-owned merged path to equal the exact coordinator tree. Wrong-tip/unmerged-tip controls refuse with rc=2; a synthetic lane edit after the merge and a synthetic edit introduced by merge resolution both fail ownership with rc=1. The genuine merge passes. Default mode, 13 steps and prior refusal semantics remain; no production tool was edited.

Final command uses the original `--since 86ebb6dffc`, 254-path source export, actual published `--commit`, and `--coordinator-tip 329011b9eae20922b4d0727e13bf1626b2e1c04f`. Full final exact-tip receipts are retained at `/workspace/tmp/m6-t39/final-4eb5dfab8e74/`; exports were retired after checking. Withheld-findings output:

Default resolution lint and `--issue 1406`: **PASS, rc=0**. Rules, register (**722 IDs**), work-log index, ceremony gate, forbidden-terms, hooks and menu-map checks: **rc=0**. New-record guard: **28 matching proof pairs**, restricted to tree/history/tool-run/fixture/design with fix commits in separate fields; all five new record controls rejected. Final `box-check` for #686, #1406 and #1400–#1405: **0 fail, rc=0**; #686/#1406 were rechecked after final body readback. Scoped history: **16 lane non-merge commits, zero lane deletions, zero removed register lines**. All retained source exports, including the two final exact-tip exports, were retired.

Criterion 5’s original *unfiltered* ancestry command necessarily includes coordinator commits after the explicitly required Stage-H merge. The exact-tip provenance check above supplies the scoped ownership proof; this wording reconciliation remains for coordinator acceptance rather than a false claim that the unfiltered log contains only lane commits.

### Outcomes and inherited work

Audit #1406’s live task list and Phase-7 YAML/table agree: **15 scoped Resolved, 22 Deferred, nine Withdrawn**. This records source disposition, not overall acceptance or shipment.

- **Deferred:** PL-17 → #23; PL-22 → #511; PL-25/27/28/29/31/33/34/35/36/40/42 → #346; PL-30 → #509; PL-32 → #1216; PL-38 → #947; PL-39 → #1013; PL-41 → #563/#559; PL-43/44/45 → #528; PL-46 → #585.
- **Mixed inherited halves:** PL-03’s rule counterpart → #346; PL-11’s upstream README share → #585 and rc-accept share remains historical; PL-15’s catalog/tool work → #964/#270; PL-18’s later organization and individual review → #1407.
- **Withdrawn recorded designs:** PL-01/14/19/20/21/23/24/26/37, with the accepted evidence and coordinator disposition preserved. PL-17 remains unverified/conditional; PL-22’s current remote fact remains unestablished.
- The six bug correction comments are posted and exactly read back: #1400 ([6586196594](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1400#issuecomment-6586196594)), #1401 ([6586197813](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1401#issuecomment-6586197813)), #1402 ([6586199573](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1402#issuecomment-6586199573)), #1403 ([6586200742](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1403#issuecomment-6586200742)), #1404 ([6586202112](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1404#issuecomment-6586202112)), #1405 ([6586203346](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1405#issuecomment-6586203346)). They remain open for normal acceptance/integration.

**Coordinator actions remaining:** accept the artifacts and merge provenance, close #1406 when accepted, handle normal integration/bug closure and the named inherited routes, and authorize the final completion marker. No physical/cloud action, runtime allocation, build, compiler, guest, fetch, provider/council call, host-ledger write, other-owner issue edit or another agent’s permission answer occurred. The closing host census has zero T39-authored lines. I am idle at this hand-back boundary in the assigned T39 tree.
